subject: [hw] DONE K02 rev 6: 273 MHz VENC default + 0311 build-break fix; 588891/588891 x3 builds; kernel 0 unknown
body:
DONE K02 rev 6. Host-tested only; nothing on the phone, nothing published, no commit (lead owns commits).

  bash gpu/hwcodec/kern/test_k02/run_tests.sh
    == clang -O1 ASan+UBSan / -O2 / -O2 -DN2VC_VENC_SLOW=0
    N2TEST K02 PASS 588891/588891 (violations 0)   (all three builds, last line)

rev 6 = root 1794413297 (273 MHz VENC default) + opus-lead 1794413826 (0311 build break). New file sha256 7ded4040... (was a939f107).
- n2vc_venc_mux(): vcodecd RWVC_POWER selects venc_sel parent 4 = mainpll_d4_d2 = 273 MHz (N2VC_VENC_SLOW=1 default; 0 -> parent 12 = 624 MHz). Only while VEN and VENC_C1 are off; a running mux is never re-muxed by anyone. Read-back required; CLK_CFG_13 bits 0-23 untouched.
- K01s shared n2vc_ven_get() selects parent 12 = 624 MHz when it powers VEN from off, so JPEG keeps the clock M1 measured (4.6 ms 1080p); if JPEG holds VEN during a vcodec job, that job runs at 624 (running mux not rewritten). Host-tested both directions.
- n2vc_acquire_locked() is now a 3-arg macro for n2vc_acquire_ex(..., 0u) (0 = never re-mux) so kern/p031x/bsd/dev/nord2_vcodec_at.inc:194,:198 compiles unchanged; opus-kern needs no edit there.
- Kernel compile proof (local, exact CI flags, -Wall -Wextra -Werror): q10at3 stage + 0298 + relay + my .inc + jpegdev + at.inc -> clean, 1,325,192 B object, 6 new undefined symbols all defined in kernel.development.nord2-metal-q10at3, 0 unknown.

Not done / open (full list in kern/test_k02/STATUS.md and dsh-state/workers/K02/STATUS.md):
1. Real interrupts (irq_mode 1) not implemented; polled sleeping mode only, as ordered. GICv3 registration proposal for hw-ik in kern/VCODEC_HW.md section 8.
2. Never run on the phone: no flash, no boot, no user-space ioctl. VEN sequence is M1-proven; VDE/VDE2/VEN_CORE1 are transcribed from clk-mt6885-pg.c and only model-tested.
3. IK must regenerate 0299 with 7ded4040 and re-run compile_check; opus-kern must rebuild the image (q10jx) with it.
4. vdec_lat_sel semantics (vde.c:214-232 declares vdec_ck as parent) [I]; VENC_C1 IRQ registers 0x1782005c/0x60 [I]; VDEC_RACING -> VDEC_CORE window [I].
5. Mux frequencies depend on bootloader PLL rates this kernel does not read [I]; 273 MHz is venc_step3 from the dts.
6. 16-bit DMA handle generation: aliasing possible after 65536 reuses of one pool slot (1024 slots).
7. 2 s per-batch RWVC_REGS budget and the 1 s/5 s clamps are kernel policy I added (header bounds one POLL at 1 s); documented in VCODEC_HW.md section 7.
8. cdevsw entry points and relay registration are kernel-only: covered by the staged compile, not by the register model.
9. header rev 3 (RWVC_WIN_VDEC_ALL, DEC04/DEC07) is not in my file yet; it needs hw-leads text. My window table is ready for a per-page check once the ABI exists.
10. include/redwood_vcodec.h still documents VENC windows as 0x2000; the kernel accepts 0x3000 (vpud mmap). Header is frozen/leads.

Files changed this rev: gpu/hwcodec/kern/bsd/dev/nord2_vcodec.inc, gpu/hwcodec/kern/VCODEC_HW.md (sections 3 parents, 9 seam), gpu/hwcodec/kern/test_k02/{t_k02.c,run_tests.sh,STATUS.md}, gpu/hwcodec/dsh-state/workers/K02/STATUS.md. Still available for review findings.
